headword: {新装開店|しんそうかいてん}

definitions.explanation: The reopening of a shop or restaurant after it has been remodeled or refurbished. Composed of {新装|しんそう} (new fittings, refurbishment) and {開店|かいてん} (opening for business).

examples.japanese: {明日|あす}{新装開店|しんそうかいてん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{新装開店|しんそうかいてん}⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}っている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: They are holding a grand-reopening sale.

examples.japanese: ⟦{改装|かいそう}→改装：09682_kaisou⟧⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{終|お}えて→終える：02019_oeru⟧、⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧{新装開店|しんそうかいてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: Having finished the remodeling work, the store is scheduled for its grand reopening next month.

notes:
A set phrase on shop signage and flyers; takes ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form a verb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新装開店|しんそうかいてん}⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧: grand-reopening sale
- {新装開店|しんそうかいてん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to reopen after renovation
- {祝|しゅく}{新装開店|しんそうかいてん}: "Celebrating our grand reopening" (banner wording)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{新規|しんき}→新規：06289_shinki⟧⟦{開店|かいてん}→開店：14569_kaiten⟧: a brand-new store opening for the first time, not a reopening
- リニューアル⟦オープン→オープン：10831_oopun⟧: a common katakana equivalent for a renovation reopening
